words.gloss_range: singular speech imperative commissioning the Prophet to voice the whole challenge
words.root_gloss_range: local imperative of saying/speaking; the bundle aligns the form under q-l-l, while the local function is commissioned speech
words.prose: {{ar:قُلْ}} ({{tr:qul}}) makes the ayah a commanded utterance before the argument begins. The singular address assigns the Prophet the role of commissioned speaker, while the following plural questions and commands put the burden on the opponents. The opening also turns the previous cosmic assertion into direct evidentiary cross-examination, so the ayah is heard as authorized challenge rather than detached narration.

words.prose: {{ar:أَرَءَيْتُم}} ({{tr:araʾaytum}}) asks for more than visual notice. Its completed form treats the opponents' evaluation as already available for inspection, while the interrogative force turns that supposed perception into a rebuke. The seeing-root will return in the later show-me command, so the ayah moves from alleged consideration to demanded demonstration.

The local grammar favors a relative pronoun, not a freestanding question, but the surface still prepares the later interrogative turn. This is why the ayah can first identify the worshipped objects and then ask what they can actually show.

The verb makes devotion sound like both appeal and claim: those they invoke are being treated as if they could answer or possess divine agency. That prepares the later tests of creation, heavenly share, and documentary warrant.

The same particle will recur with different jobs across the ayah: exclusion, earth-scope, prior time, and knowledge-specification. That repetition makes the argument advance by tightening relations rather than by simple narrative sequence.

The rivals are mentioned first, but this governed divine name determines the comparison: every invoked power must be measured against God, not against another rival. The repeated seeing-root marks an escalation from “consider this” to “show the created thing.”

Whether parsed as one interrogative unit or as a relative-style construction, the local effect is the same: the opponents must name an actual created thing. The move from the earlier relative {{ar:مَّا}} ({{tr:mā}}) to this interrogative raises the pressure from identifying objects of worship to specifying evidence.

The plural agency is assigned to the alleged rivals only so their incapacity can be exposed. Because the creation-earth pairing is a familiar Quranic field, the ayah turns the very language of divine creation against those who cannot meet it.

The partitive/source range is locally useful because both readings keep the demand concrete. As the second occurrence of this recurring particle, it contrasts with the earlier exclusion phrase and shifts the argument into material evidence.

The singular definite earth is treated as one accessible test-field before the challenge moves upward to the plural heavens. Together the lower earth-domain and upper heavenly-domain form a comprehensive survey of where rival power would have to appear.

It is the first admissible proof route beside the later trace of knowledge, and its indefiniteness prevents the demand from naming a single scripture; instead, it asks for any prior record that could warrant the rival claim. The surah later returns to real book-authority in 46:12 and 46:30, making this missing rival document stand out.

words.prose: {{ar:أَثَٰرَةٍ}} ({{tr:athāratin}}) is the fallback proof at its thinnest: even a residual trace would be enough. The indefinite noun under the concessive particle makes the evidentiary bar minimal, while the following phrase restricts the trace to knowledge rather than rumor or status. Its rare nominal form and root family make the remnant feel like something surfaced from prior knowledge; related root scenes in 30:9 and 35:9 involve stirring or bringing up the earth, but here the selected sense is evidentiary trace.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The paired seeing and showing verbs at words 2 and 8, the creation and share alternatives at words 10 and 15, and the book and trace alternatives at words 19 and 24.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah stages an escalating audit. It begins by making the addressees inspect their own claim, asks for an attributable product on the lower visible plane, allows the alternative of demonstrable participation in the upper order, and then requests either organized documentation or a surviving mark. The truth clause makes each route answerable to evidence rather than assertion.

activation_trace.role: The alerting interrogative use makes the audience report what it actually takes itself to know and opens the audit.
Active disclosure turns the claim from something merely said into something that must be put on display.
Origination supplies the first and strongest production test: identify something these beings brought into existence.
Participation supplies the alternative test of an attributable portion or role within the celestial order.
Joined and ordered writing provides a documentary route for a claim that cannot be demonstrated by an artifact.
A remaining sign supplies the residual route: a past act may still be known through what it left behind.
Agreement between speech and reality closes the audit by making evidence the condition of truthful assertion.

changed_reading.before: A general rhetorical denial that other deities created anything.
changed_reading.after: A falsifiable, multi-channel audit that permits material, jurisdictional, documentary, and residual evidence, yet finds the claimants unable to produce any of them.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The juxtaposition of a claimed share at word 15 with a book from before at words 19-21 and a transmitted trace at word 24.
baseline_models.mechanism: The vocabulary supports a jurisdictional reading. A share is not established by devotion alone; it needs a prior warrant, binding record, or transmitted chain showing how that share was granted. The request resembles an audit of title to cosmic authority rather than a request for any impressive old text.

activation_trace.role: A jointly held portion supplies the legal and social relation whose authorization is being challenged.
A written determination that fixes obligation or judgment supplies the image of an authoritative charter rather than bare writing.
Temporal precedence requires the alleged authorization to predate the present challenge and gives it a chain-of-title function.
A report preserved through transmission supplies the non-documentary alternative to a formal charter.
Veracity requires the alleged warrant and the asserted share to correspond to an actual grant.

changed_reading.before: Bring any earlier scripture that mentions the invoked beings.
changed_reading.after: Produce an antecedent warrant or preserved chain that actually authorizes their claimed share in governance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The compact construction joining the trace at word 24 to knowledge at word 26, after the repeated demand to see.
baseline_models.mechanism: The trace and knowledge roots reinforce one another as sign language. A residue counts only when it distinguishes its cause and can guide an observer toward knowledge. The ayah therefore does not accept mere antiquity, unexplained objects, or inherited rumor as proof; it asks for a residue with evidentiary resolution.

activation_trace.role: A durable remainder points backward to a prior cause and supplies the physical side of the evidentiary sign.
A distinguishing marker that guides its reader supplies the interpretive side that makes a remainder probative.
Disclosure to a knower states the result required from the trace: not fascination, but warranted recognition.
Perception by eye or insight supplies the reader who must connect the surviving mark to what it demonstrates.

changed_reading.before: A trace is any relic or fragment inherited from the past.
changed_reading.after: The requested trace must be legible as knowledge: a discriminating remainder that can identify and support the alleged causal claim.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The beings called at word 4 are located beneath or other than God at word 6 before their alleged share is tested at word 15.
baseline_models.mechanism: The spatial relation can include beings imagined as near but below the ultimate goal, not only fully independent rivals. The ayah tests delegated mediation as rigorously as competing divinity: invocation, subordinate location, and alleged participation together require evidence of an actual authorized function.

activation_trace.role: Calling that draws an addressee toward the caller supplies the operative relationship claimed with these beings.
Nearness that remains short of the goal supplies the model of a subordinate intermediary rather than only a distant rival.
The relation of worship identifies the ultimate divine referent against whom the subordinate claim is measured.
Participation supplies the alleged delegated function that would make mediation more than projected devotion.

changed_reading.before: The ayah addresses only rival creator-gods set wholly apart from God.
changed_reading.after: It also audits subordinate mediators: proximity, invocation, and claimed participation do not establish delegated authority.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The creation question at word 10 is immediately paired with the alternative of a share at word 15 across earth and heavens.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation can be heard as prior measuring and proportioning as well as origination. Paired with participation, the challenge asks for an identifiable design allocation: what did the invoked beings specify, proportion, or administer within the earth-heavens system? This is a test of ordered causal competence, not only manufacture.

activation_trace.role: Measuring and proportioning supplies the design dimension of creation and makes ordered contribution testable.
Bringing creation into existence keeps the design reading tethered to effective production rather than abstract planning.
The lower plane supplies the inspectable domain in which an alleged allocation should leave products.
The encompassing upper realm supplies the larger order in which an alleged share would have to be located.
A joint portion turns measured creation into an allocation question: identify the other party's actual contribution.

changed_reading.before: Show an object independently manufactured by the invoked beings.
changed_reading.after: Identify any measurable design, proportion, or effective allocation attributable to them within the created order.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding context supplies the positive comparator that the focus challenge leaves implicit: a book is presently delivered from God, while the heavens and earth are created in stable correspondence with reality and a fixed term. The absent warrant for the invoked beings is thus contrasted with both an identified communication and an ordered creation.

activation_trace.role: Ordered writing is the documentary channel whose requested prior instance anchors this delta in the focus ayah.
Delivery from above supplies an actual, sourced communication against which the requested book can be compared.
The present organized text supplies the positive documentary object immediately before the challenge for an older one.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the governing quality of creation and the benchmark for a truthful claim.
A bounded appointed duration supplies temporal order, making creation a governed system rather than an unexplained mass.

structural_cues: 46:2 identifies a present book before 46:4 requests a book from before.
46:3 repeats creation, heavens, and earth immediately before the focus ayah repeats them as the audit domain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a delivered book and creation ordered by reality and term; I infer that they function as positive comparators to the missing idol evidence. A live alternative is that 46:2-3 establish divine authorship generally without defining the focus ayah's proof procedure.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah asks for evidence in an otherwise neutral field.
changed_reading.after: It asks for rival evidence in a field already occupied by a sourced book and a temporally ordered creation, making the rivals' evidentiary absence sharper.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context operationalizes invocation as a reciprocal relation. The called beings do not answer, remain unaware, reverse into enemies, fail to help despite being taken as offerings of proximity, and provide no protective alliance. The focus question about creation or celestial participation therefore becomes a stress test of practical agency and authorized mediation.

activation_trace.role: Calling establishes the relation whose capacity for response and aid the context subsequently tests.
A near but subordinate position supplies the mediation claim that would require dependable access and protection.
Participation supplies the alleged functional share that failed response and protection would disconfirm.
Returning an answer supplies the minimal reciprocal act that the invoked beings cannot perform.
Being outside awareness supplies the cognitive failure behind their non-response.
Enmity supplies the social reversal of the claimed devotional alliance when the parties are gathered.
Aid that makes its beneficiary prevail supplies the protective function the supposed gods fail to deliver.
An offering intended to secure nearness supplies the cultic mechanism by which the beings were treated as intermediaries.
Protective affection and alliance supply the final relational function explicitly denied to those placed beneath God.

structural_cues: 46:5 repeats the focus ayah's calling and subordinate-location construction, then adds non-response.
46:6 reverses worship into enmity, while 46:28 and 46:32 return to failed help and absent allies.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies call, non-response, unawareness, enmity, failed aid, and absent alliance; I infer that response and protection are functional tests of a claimed mediator's share. A live alternative is that these are consequences of false worship rather than criteria embedded in 46:4 itself.

changed_reading.before: The focus ayah asks only whether the invoked beings once produced a cosmic object.
changed_reading.after: It also asks whether they possess any current, reciprocal agency: awareness, answer, aid, stable alliance, or authorized mediation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context fills out the focus ayah's documentary alternative as a chain of custody. A witness speaks from knowledge, the book of Moses precedes, the present book confirms, and the later hearers identify a book delivered after Moses that confirms what lies before it. A prior book or transmitted trace must therefore fit a cross-checkable sequence, not merely be old.

activation_trace.role: An authoritative written determination anchors the delta in the focus demand for a warrant rather than any writing.
Preserved transmission supplies the alternative chain by which knowledge can survive without the original document.
Testimony grounded in knowledge supplies an independently reportable link in the evidentiary chain.
The two organized texts in one ayah supply an explicit earlier-and-present documentary sequence.
Making an earlier claim come true in a later act supplies confirmation rather than mere chronological succession.
A delivered book supplies a source event that later hearers can place after Moses within the chain.
Fulfilled correspondence with what precedes supplies the cross-check that stabilizes the chain across time.

structural_cues: 46:12 verbally answers the focus phrase about a book from before by placing Moses's book before the present one.
46:30 repeats the same sequence from the perspective of new hearers and adds confirmation of what precedes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies witness, temporal succession, two books, and repeated confirmation; I infer a chain-of-custody standard for the requested evidence. A live alternative is that each item independently supports revelation without forming a single archival protocol.

changed_reading.before: Any ancient text or inherited report could satisfy the request if it mentioned the invoked beings.
changed_reading.after: The requested evidence must enter a witnessed, temporally located, mutually confirming transmission chain.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context limits both the knower and the perceiver. The messenger disclaims independent knowledge and follows disclosed news; knowledge is located with God; and hearing, sight, and inward faculties fail to avail people who knowingly reject signs. The focus command to show evidence is therefore not naive empiricism. Perception must be joined to warranted disclosure, understanding, and honest reception.

activation_trace.role: Seeing by eye or insight anchors the delta in the focus ayah's repeated appeal to perception.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the epistemic result that perception alone cannot guarantee.
Acquired knowledge supplies the capacity the messenger explicitly refuses to claim independently.
News or inspiration from God supplies the warranted source that replaces unsupported foresight.
Knowledge located with God supplies an explicit boundary on the human claimant's epistemic authority.
Understanding and compliance supply the unrealized function of hearing, beyond mere reception of sound.
Inner discernment supplies the unrealized function of sight, beyond registering a visible surface.
Denial despite knowledge supplies the mechanism by which available faculties cease to yield acknowledgment.

structural_cues: 46:9 places an epistemic disclaimer soon after the focus challenge, while 46:23 repeats that knowledge is with God.
46:26 inventories hearing and sight but states that they did not avail their possessors.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded knowledge, divine disclosure, unused faculties, and knowing denial; I infer that honest uptake mediates between a displayed sign and knowledge. A live alternative is that these passages concern obedience and prophetic humility without qualifying the proof request itself.

changed_reading.before: Once an object is shown, sight automatically settles the claim.
changed_reading.after: Showing initiates an evidentiary process, but warranted source, discernment, and truthful reception determine whether the visible becomes knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated confirmation and the promise characterized by truth activate a performative branch of truth. In the focus closing condition, being truthful can therefore require more than accurate speech: the claim about the invoked beings must be realized in a fulfilled act, dependable promise, or effective function.

activation_trace.role: Speech matching its object supplies the ordinary truth test from which the contextual revision begins.
Making a claim or promise actual in deed supplies the stronger performative criterion latent in the same focus word.
A later book realizing and confirming what precedes supplies an enacted form of correspondence across time.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies the future-directed claim that truth must eventually fulfill.
Fulfillment in action supplies the quality that makes the promise dependable rather than merely well phrased.
The opponents' demand that a promised outcome be brought supplies a hostile but explicit test of claim by realization.

structural_cues: Truth language recurs with a confirming book in 46:12 and a promise in 46:16.
46:22 pairs a demand to bring the promised event with the same conditional truth formula used in the focus ayah.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies confirmation, promise, and demanded realization; I infer that the focus truth condition can test performance as well as verbal accuracy. A live alternative is that the repeated formula is only conventional challenge language and leaves the lexical sense at truthful speech.

changed_reading.before: The closing condition asks whether the speakers sincerely state a proposition.
changed_reading.after: It also asks whether their claim can become true in performance: can the alleged partners deliver the creative, protective, or authorizing function attributed to them?

context_deltas.mechanism: The cloud episode separates seeing from correct classification. A visible phenomenon approaching the valleys is read as beneficial rain but proves destructive; afterward only dwellings remain visible, and nearby settlements become repeatedly varied signs. This changes the focus pair of showing and trace: a surface appearance may mislead, while an absence framed by a surviving remainder may disclose the real cause.

activation_trace.role: Eye and insight together anchor the delta in the focus demand to inspect rather than merely hear a claim.
A surviving indication anchors the contextual dwellings as an analogy for evidence left after an absent cause or population.
Something appearing from a direction supplies the ambiguous visible object that observers prematurely classify.
Rain that descends as harm supplies the reversal hidden inside what the observers expected to be beneficial weather.
Comprehensive destruction supplies the causal event no longer directly visible after it passes.
Restricted visibility supplies the aftermath in which what is not seen becomes as evidentially important as what remains.
Places of settled habitation supply the durable remainder from which the vanished inhabitants and event are inferred.
Turning signs through different forms supplies repeated interpretive opportunities rather than a single self-explaining sight.

structural_cues: 46:24 repeats seeing but records an incorrect interpretation of what is seen.
46:25 follows destruction with a visual field containing only dwellings, and 46:27 labels nearby ruined settlements through varied signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a misclassified appearance, destructive reversal, restricted aftermath, and remaining dwellings; I infer that the dwellings function as an evidentiary trace and that absence can be legible. A live alternative is that the sequence illustrates punishment alone and does not qualify the focus ayah's epistemology.

changed_reading.before: Visible presence is straightforward proof, while a trace is a weaker substitute for sight.
changed_reading.after: Visible surfaces can be misread, whereas a properly interpreted remainder, including conspicuous absence around what survives, can carry stronger causal knowledge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The final movement supplies a positive counterpart to the failed invocation. Hearers attend to a gathered recitation, listen in silence, return as warners, and command their people to answer God's caller. Agency is shown as a reproducible response chain: receive, understand, answer, and transmit. The beings called in the focus ayah generate none of these effects.

activation_trace.role: Calling establishes the focus relation whose productive counterpart appears when hearers answer and become callers themselves.
Understanding that issues in compliance supplies effective hearing rather than passive sound reception.
Recitation supplies the transmissible content around which the responsive audience gathers.
Attentive silence supplies the receptive posture that allows the call to become understood evidence.
Returning an answer supplies the decisive relational act absent from the beings invoked beneath God.
A caller who draws others by speech supplies the reversed grammar: the proper call now has a messenger, content, and expected response.

structural_cues: The root for calling shifts from the object of human invocation in 46:4-5 to God's caller in 46:31.
46:29-31 forms a sequence of hearing, attentive silence, return, warning, and answering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a complete reception-and-response sequence; I infer that productive response is positive evidence of live agency and that its absence exposes the focus objects. A live alternative is that the later call concerns human responsibility without serving as a direct comparator to invoked beings.

changed_reading.before: Calling is primarily the worshipper's act directed toward a sacred object.
changed_reading.after: A valid call is evidenced by a response network that receives, understands, answers, and retransmits; inert invocation has no such causal output.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the close, the context deliberately reprises seeing, God, creation, heavens, and earth, then asks whether the creator was unable and asserts effective capacity over restoring the dead. This closes the focus audit by extending creation from a past artifact to continuing, measured power. A genuine creator is not merely associated with origins but can execute the order's next transformation.

activation_trace.role: Measured design anchors the delta in the focus demand for an attributable contribution to ordered creation.
An alleged joint portion anchors the question of whether any other agent possesses effective capacity within that order.
Perception by eye or insight reopens the same evidentiary posture used in the focus ayah.
Proportioned creation is repeated as the established work from which present capacity is inferred.
Failure to find the way to an act supplies the incapacity explicitly denied of the creator.
Effective enablement reaching action and dominion supplies the positive capacity inferred from creation.
Loss of life supplies the apparently final condition over which continuing creative capacity is tested.

structural_cues: 46:33 repeats the focus sequence of seeing, God, creating, heavens, and earth before adding ability and restored life.
The late reprise functions as a lexical return to the initial creation challenge rather than an unrelated topic shift.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a near-verbatim lexical reprise followed by inability and capacity; I infer a causal arrow from demonstrated creation to power for re-creation. A live alternative is that 46:33 independently argues resurrection and only echoes 46:4 rhetorically.

changed_reading.before: The creation test concerns only a recoverable product from the remote past.
changed_reading.after: The test concerns durable causal capacity: ordered creation should entail power to continue, transform, and restore life.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping for the trace word and should not replace its ordinary residual or transmitted senses. It remains anchored in word 24, the imperative to produce evidence, and the later variation of signs. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory resonance: the challenge may ask claimants to raise any latent proof into view, not translate the word as stirring.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The trace noun at word 24 appears inside an imperative demand to bring evidence into the open.

activation_trace.role: Moving something from its place supplies an image of eliciting or excavating proof that had remained unavailable.
Emergence and visible spread after concealment supply the result demanded of any allegedly latent knowledge.
Turning signs through multiple states supplies a contextual analogy for drawing different evidentiary forms into notice.

changed_reading.before: The claimants may point to a static remnant already lying in view.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the imperative challenges them to excavate, activate, or raise whatever supposedly hidden knowledge could become inspectable proof.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it activates the packet's split mapping from the paired seeing verbs into deliberation and report-transmission. It remains worth carrying because the focus ayah itself moves from showing to book and preserved report, and context adds knowledgeable witness. Downstream prose should label it a phonetic or mapped-root resonance, never an alternative lexical translation of the seeing verbs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two seeing verbs at words 2 and 8 govern a sequence that ends with documentary and transmitted evidence.

activation_trace.role: Carrying and transmitting a report supplies an exploratory second channel inside the repeated demand to see and show.
Deliberative consideration supplies the reflective act needed to assess the displayed or reported evidence.
A report preserved through transmission supplies the focus ayah's explicit bridge from direct display to narrated knowledge.
A witness speaking from knowledge supplies the contextual form of a report that is answerable to what was known.

changed_reading.before: The repeated verbs demand only immediate ocular demonstration.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they braid inspection with reliable narration: what can be seen, thoughtfully assessed, and carried forward as a knowledgeable report?

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's split mapping from the heavens root to visible marking; the normal celestial sense remains controlling. It is still anchored by the heavenly-share question and the nearby trace-plus-marker construction. Downstream prose should render it only as an audit image: inspect the heavens for an identifying mark of participation, not redefine the heavens as marks.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The alleged share in the heavens at words 15-17 is followed by a request for a knowledge-bearing trace at words 24-26.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark supplies the exploratory image of a celestial order bearing attribution to its alleged participant.
A sign from which an observer reads a condition supplies the mechanism for inspecting the alleged heavenly share.
A durable indication supplies the kind of attributable remainder that the heavens would need to exhibit.
A marker that distinguishes and guides supplies the interpretive criterion for any alleged celestial signature.

changed_reading.before: A heavenly share is an invisible jurisdictional assertion.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, even that assertion is pressed toward inspectability: where is the identifying mark or signature of the alleged participant in the celestial order?

strongest_changes: Invocation becomes a functional test of awareness, response, aid, and stable alliance rather than only a label for worship.
The requested prior book or trace becomes a witnessed and mutually confirming chain rather than any ancient object.
The cloud, destruction, and remaining dwellings distinguish raw visibility from correctly interpreted residue.
The late creation reprise extends the audit from past products to continuing capacity for transformation and restored life.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah already permits several proof channels instead of forcing one, and the context differentiates them further: present revelation, causal workmanship, delegated function, historical transmission, perceptual interpretation, and performed truth. The split mappings also activate contained but coherent readings of elicited evidence, seeing as report, and the heavens as an inspectable marked order.
remaining_uncertainties: The charter or title-deed force of the book branch is coherent with partnership language but remains an analogy rather than a required legal register.
The report, stirring, and marking outliers depend on non-dominant mapped roots and should remain resonances rather than translations.
The cloud-to-dwellings sequence may be primarily a punishment narrative rather than a direct instruction about evidence interpretation.
The contextual promise language makes performed truth plausible, but the focus closing condition may still intend verbal truthfulness alone.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Seeing converted into evidentiary production.** ر ء ي B013 is the “tell me” formula and B012 is making something seen. The doubled movement `أرأيتم ... أروني` first solicits a judgment and then demands an exhibit. Earthly creation, heavenly share, prior book, and inherited trace form an escalating evidence ladder. I infer that a claim to worship must cross from opinion into demonstrable production. The ayah reads as a procedural examination, not only a rhetorical question.
2. **Two admissible forms of continuity.** ك ت ب B002 supplies joined letters and written book, while أ ث ر B003 is a remaining sign pointing to what was and B002 is a transmitted report. Their alternative construction permits either an assembled record or a residual/transmitted trace. I infer that continuity with prior knowledge is the test shared by both. The challenge therefore does not demand only a text; it preserves documentary and trace-based proof as distinct routes.
3. **Partnership exposed as a claimed stake.** ش ر ك B001 is sharing and partnership, sharpened by the contrast between الأرض and السماوات. The invoked beings must show either what they originated below or what share they hold above. I infer that worship claims presuppose an effective stake in cosmic agency. `شرك` thus reads as an alleged operational partnership whose absence can be audited.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 46:12 and 46:30 unexpectedly answer the demanded prior-book continuity from within the packet, while 46:25 leaves visible dwellings as an `أثارة`-like residual sign. These later forms confirmed that written record and material trace remain separate evidentiary channels.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Invocation is converted into an auditable ownership claim.** `تَدْعُونَ` activates د ع و B002, claiming a right or affiliation, while `شِرْكٌ` activates ش ر ك B001, an actual shared portion or partnership. The doubled visual construction, `أَرَءَيْتُم ... أَرُونِى`, moves from ر ء ي B013, “tell me,” to B012, making something seen. The packet supplies claim, share, and compelled display; I infer that treating an invoked object as effective implicitly assigns it title to some part of creation. The ayah thus asks the callers to expose the asset or jurisdiction behind their religious claim, not merely to name an object of devotion.

2. **The proof must have survived transmission or left a mark.** `بِكِتَٰبٍ` can invoke ك ت ب B002, a joined written record, and B003, a binding decree; `أَثَٰرَةٍ` invokes ء ث ر B002, transmitted knowledge, and B003, a remaining sign of what occurred. The preceding ayah supplies measured creation and a named term; 46:7-8 add clear recitation and a witness between parties. The packet gives documentary, residual, and testimonial modes; I infer that a genuine share in cosmic production would be detectable in at least one durable evidentiary channel. The alternatives therefore constitute an evidence protocol: produce either an authorizing record or an empirical/transmitted remainder, rather than an inherited assertion.

3. **“Besides” also marks structural shortfall.** Fixed `مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ` permits د و ن B001, nearness that remains below or short of the limit, alongside B003, other-than. In 46:5 the called object never answers, and in 46:6 it becomes an enemy and disavows the worship. The packet supplies the lower station and the failed performance; I infer that substitution favors what seems near or accessible while mistaking proximity for capacity. The phrase now reads as a diagnosis of selecting an intermediary precisely at a level that cannot reach the claimed creative or responsive function.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 46:5–6 completed the requested audit in relational rather than material form: the invoked objects cannot answer through ج و ب B003 and finally disavow the projected bond through ك ف ر B005. Those later failures confirmed that د و ن B001 at 46:4 marks functional shortfall, not merely the location of a competing name.

baseline.text: De ki: Allah'ın dışında çağırdıklarınızı gördünüz mü? Bana gösterin: Onlar yerden ne yarattılar? Yoksa göklerde bir ortaklıkları mı var? Doğru söylüyorsanız bana bundan önceki bir kitap ya da bilgiden kalma bir iz getirin.

findings.text: Çağrılan varlıklara yönelmek, onlara yaratılış üzerinde gerçek bir pay ya da yetki atfetmek demektir; iki görme buyruğu bu iddiayı denetlenebilir bir kanıt göstermeye zorlar.
Önceki bilgiyle süreklilik için iki ayrı kanıt yolu korunur: bağlayıcı yazılı kayıt ve geçmişten kalan ya da aktarılan iz.
Allah'ın dışında seçilen aracılar yakın ve erişilebilir görünseler de yaratma ve karşılık verme düzeyine erişemeyen yapısal bir eksiklik taşır.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A true communication leaves ordered, transmissible marks that can be read, witnessed, and followed.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The branch images turn abstract proof into a material chain of stitching, inscription, landmarks, testimony, and tracked passage.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Joined marks become durable evidence
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Separate marks are joined into an ordered inscription whose surviving trace can function as a landmark.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Joined material (`quranic:root_001283:B001/m01`); ordered written letters (`quranic:root_001283:B002/m01`); a remaining trace (`quranic:root_000011:B003/m01`); a distinguishing landmark (`quranic:root_001040:B002/m01`); a visible sign (`quranic:root_000074:B003/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Scripture and requested evidence occupy one evidentiary scene: joined signs endure, distinguish a route, and remain available for inspection.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A claimed relation is exposed by whether a call completes a response circuit and whether the claimed party remains allied under assembly.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: The latent imagery recasts theology as a failed communication system followed by a public reversal of roles.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: The invocation circuit remains open
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A call is projected toward an absent target, but no answering movement returns and the target remains inattentive.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Calling or attraction by speech (`quranic:root_000478:B001/m01`); a reply that meets a call (`quranic:root_000273:B003/m01`); inattentive lapse (`quranic:root_001097:B001/m01`); a lost or vanished object (`quranic:root_000913:B003/m01`); claimed partnership (`quranic:root_000791:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `تدعون من دون الله` (46:4), `من يدعو من دون الله` and `لا يستجيب له` (46:5), `عن دعائهم غافلون` (46:5), and `لهم شرك` (46:4).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Nonresponse is not incidental silence; it diagnoses the invoked relation as lost, inattentive, and incapable of completing the claim of partnership.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Falsehood is manufactured by joining or covering material, then maintained by redirecting perception and trapping inquiry.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Lexical branches materialize polemical labels as workshop operations and hunting techniques.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Rival claims become a hunting scene
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A decoy relation is set, tracks are demanded, and perception is diverted before the quarry can follow a reliable trace.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: A hunter's snare (`quranic:root_000791:B006/m01`); a hoof mark used for tracking (`quranic:root_000011:B008/m01`); deceptive diversion (`quranic:root_000682:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `لهم شرك في السماوات` and `ائتوني ... أثارة من علم` (46:4), and `هذا سحر مبين` (46:7).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The demand for evidence tests whether the alleged partnership leaves a real track; without one, the claim operates more like a snare coupled to misdirection.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What comes from beyond the immediate scene arrives through a route and is received either as evidence or as prepared provision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Watercourse and hospitality branches give revelation's arrival hydraulic and residential dimensions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Incoming proof follows a channel and gathers
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Something called for comes from elsewhere, enters a channel or hollow, and can overflow into the receiving field.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: A water channel (`quranic:root_000009:B004/m01`); a flood arriving from elsewhere (`quranic:root_000009:B005/m01`); a water hollow or basin (`quranic:root_000281:B003/m01`); overflow and spreading (`quranic:root_001192:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `ائتوني بكتاب` (46:4), `الحق لما جاءهم` (46:7), and `إذ تفيضون فيه` (46:8).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The requested proof and the arrived truth are reframed as incoming flow: the issue is whether the receiving basin contains and examines it or lets discourse spill around it.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: What comes from beyond the immediate scene arrives through a route and is received either as evidence or as prepared provision.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Watercourse and hospitality branches give revelation's arrival hydraulic and residential dimensions.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Descent is a prepared lodging
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: An arriving communication is brought down, made present, and furnished like a ration or lodging prepared for a guest.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: Descent or arrival (`quranic:root_001492:B001/m01`); a delivered descent (`quranic:root_001492:B002/m01`); a prepared guest ration (`quranic:root_001492:B005/m01`); arrival from elsewhere (`quranic:root_000009:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: `تنزيل الكتاب` (46:2) and `ائتوني بكتاب من قبل هذا` (46:4).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Revelation's descent is not bare vertical motion; it is an arrival furnished for reception, which sharpens the contrast with a demand that refuses the provision already present.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı sesle ortaya çıkarılan söz ve harflerden kurulu sözlü ifade olarak verir. Geçici çerçeve aynı çekirdeği taşıyor; dil organı, hükümdar unvanı ve mecazi yan kullanımlar bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal çıplak söz söyleme ve söylenmiş söz çekirdeğidir; organ, unvan, söylenti ve mecazlar ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam bare olduğu için tanım çıplak söyleme ve sözlü ifade anlamıyla sınırlıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek işlem, sözü sesli olarak dışa çıkarmaktır.
Söylenen şey tek söz, cümle, şiir veya konuşma ölçeğinde olabilir.
Ad biçimleri aynı söylenmiş söz alanında toplanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, sözü sesle dışa çıkarılan ve harflerden oluşan sözlü ifade çekirdeğinde toplar; ad biçimleri de aynı alana bağlıdır.

source_note.MU: Tekil aktarım, bir şeye içten önem verme anlamındaki kalıp kullanımını verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi düşünce bilimi bağlamında sözün bir şeyin tanımı veya sınır bildirimi için kullanıldığını açıklar. Bu, normal konuşma değil, teknik tanım işleviyle sınırlı bir kalıptır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam collocation olduğu için tanım, teknik tanım bildiren özel kalıplara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Düşünce bilimi bağlamında bir şeyin ne olduğunu belirleyen tanım veya sınır bildirimi için söz kelimesinin kullanılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, sözün bir şeyin tanımı veya sınırı olarak kullanılmasıdır.
Kullanım teknik düşünce bilimi bağlamıyla sınırlıdır.

branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه القول المنطوق العادي إلا إذا أريد به الحد.
branches.source_phrase_ar: يستعمله المنطقيون في معنى الحد فيقولون قول الجوهر كذا وقول العرض كذا أي حدهما (mufradat)

source_note.MU: Tekil aktarım, teknik bağlamda sözün bir şeyin tanımı anlamında kullanılmasını verir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sesli bir hitap gelmeden anlamın kişinin içine doğmasını ve bunun söz diye adlandırılmasını anlatır. Çerçeve, işitilen konuşmadan ayrılan içe doğan anlam aktarımını doğru yakalar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal içe doğan anlam aktarımıdır; işitilen sözlü hitap değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Mekanik kapsam non_bare olduğu için tanım özel içe doğma bağlamıyla sınırlıdır.

concept_map.definition: İşitilen bir hitap olmadan, bir anlamın kişinin içine doğması ve bunun söz diye adlandırılmasıdır.

facets.statement: Çekirdek anlam, sözsüz biçimde içe doğan anlam aktarımıdır.
Bu kullanım işitilen hitabı özellikle dışarıda bırakır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt bu özel dalı tek bir aktarım üzerinden verir; ortaklaştırılacak ayrı bir çok kaynaklı iddia yoktur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal kişinin içinde bulunan fakat söylemediği sözdür.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İkisi de iç zihinsel söz veya anlam alanındadır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalda anlam kişiye gelmiş sayılır; komşu dalda kişinin içinde tuttuğu ve henüz dışa vurmadığı söz vardır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Aday komşular iletim, çağrı, ses, beden eğilmesi ve kökün iç söz dalları açısından tarandı; sessiz iç anlam sınırı yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القول في الإلهام، حيث يسمى إلقاء المعنى قولا من غير خطاب وارد.
branches.what_is_not_ar: لا يدخل فيه الخطاب اللفظي المسموع.
branches.source_phrase_ar: في الإلهام فإن ذلك لم يكن بخطاب ورد عليه بل كان ذلك إلهاما فسماه قولا (mufradat)

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, sesle söze dökme çekirdeğinden konuşma organı, konuşkan kişi, eski unvan, yalan isnat, söylenti, müzakere, hüküm dayatma, iç söz, görüş benimseme, sözsüz belirtme, içten önemseme, teknik tanım ve içe doğan anlam gibi ayrı dallara yayılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi azlığı çokluğun karşıtı olarak verir; ayrıca yoksulluk, düşüklük, bir şeyi az görme ve belirli yapılarda yokluğa ya da seyrekliğe yaklaşan kullanımları açıkça destekler.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol yalnızca sayı ve miktar azlığını ve buna bağlı kullanımları kapsar; yükseklik, kap, taşıma ve titreme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Temel azlık anlamı ile yoksullaşma ve az görme gibi türemiş biçimler birlikte bulunur; yokluk ve seyrekleşme anlamları ise yalnızca belirtilen yapılara bağlıdır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin sayı, miktar ya da ölçü bakımından çok olmayışını bildirir. Bundan yoksulluk ve düşüklük, bir şeyi az sayma veya az gösterme ve belirli yapılarda hiçlik ya da seyrek gerçekleşme anlamları gelişir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından çok olmayışıdır.
Azlık, kişinin yoksullaşması veya toplum içinde düşük ve değersiz görülmesi sonucuna uzanabilir.
Bir şeyi gerçekte ya da değerlendiren kişinin gözünde az sayma ve az gösterme anlamını taşır.
Belirli olumsuzluk ve sıklık yapılarında hiç yokluğu veya bir eylemin pek seyrek gerçekleşmesini anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar azlığın temel sayı ve miktar karşıtlığında birleşir; yoksulluk ve düşüklük, az sayma ve bazı yapılarda yokluğa yaklaşan kullanım bu çekirdeğin düzenli uzantılarıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Sayı, miktar veya ölçünün çok olmayışını bildiren temel anlam için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Çokluğun karşıtı olan sayı ve miktar azlığını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin sayı veya miktar bakımından çok olmadığının söylendiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel azlık durumunu doğal bir Türkçe yapıyla tam olarak verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Azlığın kişide yoksulluk ve toplumsal düşüklük sonucu doğurduğu bağlamlara özgüdür.

error_profile.preserves: Yoksulluk ile düşüklük arasındaki kaynakta kurulan uzantıyı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir miktarın veya verilen bir şeyin yetersiz ya da küçük sayıldığı değerlendirme bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Değerlendiren kişinin bir şeyi az sayması anlamını tam olarak korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yalnızca sıklığı çok düşüren veya olumsuzluğu pekiştiren kalıplaşmış yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kalıba bağlı seyrekleşme ve yokluğa yaklaşma değerlerini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol azlığı yoksulluk, düşüklük, az sayma ve kalıba bağlı yokluk değerlerine kadar genişletir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol genel azlığı özellikle mal, yiyecek ve verili miktar örnekleri çevresinde toplar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da bir şeyin sayı veya miktar bakımından çok olmayışını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Temel azlık alanları büyük ölçüde örtüşür; ancak bu kolun değerlendirme, toplumsal sonuç ve kalıba bağlı olumsuzluk uzantıları komşu kartta aynı sınırla kurulmaz.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kolun çekirdeği sayı ve miktar azlığıdır; değersizlik bunun ikincil bir sonucudur.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kolun çekirdeği güçsüzlük, aşağılık ve düşünme yetisindeki zayıflıktır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da azlıkla değersizlik veya düşüklük arasında anlam ilişkisi kurabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kolda değersizlik azlığın uzantısıdır; komşu kolda ise zayıflık ve aşağılık bağımsız çekirdektir, bu yüzden olağan kullanımda birbirlerinin yerine geçmezler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol bir şeyin sayıca veya miktarca az oluşunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol bir şeyin başını, tepesini veya en üst bölümünü bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ses benzerliği anlam birliği doğurmaz: biri çokluğun karşıtı olan azlığı, diğeri uzamsal olarak en üstte bulunan baş veya tepeyi adlandırır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; genel azlıkla en yakın örtüşme, değersizlikle kurulan yan ilişki ve aynı kökteki tepe anlamıyla olası karışma en açıklayıcı üç sınır olarak seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: القليل والقِلَّة ضد الكثرة، ويدخل فيه الافتقار والذلة، وتقليل الشيء في العين، واستقلاله، واستعمال القليل للنفي أو للندرة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس علو الشيء ولا الجرة ولا الحمل ولا الرعدة
branches.source_phrase_ar: القل القليل؛ رماه الله بالقل والذل أي بالقلة والذلة (jamhara)؛ شيء قليل وجمعه قلل؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة؛ قلله في عينه؛ أقل افتقر؛ استقله عده قليلا (sihah)؛ قل الشيء يقل قلة فهو قليل وقلال؛ القل من الرجال الخسيس الدنيء؛ قليلة ولا كثيرة؛ قليلا ما يؤمنون؛ قاللت لفلان؛ تقاللت ما أعطاني (tahdhib)؛ القلة والكثرة يستعملان في الأعداد؛ يكنى بالقلة عن الذلة؛ يكنى بها تارة عن العزة؛ قليل يعبر به عن النفي (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyin en üstünü veya başını çekirdek anlam olarak verir; dağın yuvarlak üst bölümü, insan başı ve kılıcın başındaki topuz bu çekirdeğin açık uzmanlaşmalarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol uzamsal başı ve en üst parçayı bildirir; sayısal azlık ya da büyük kap anlamını içermez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Genel baş ve en üst bölüm anlamı ile dağ tepesi, insan başı ve kılıç topuzu gibi yapıya bağlı uzmanlaşmalar ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başını veya en üst bölümünü bildirir. Dağın üstteki yuvarlak parçası, insan başı ve kılıcın sap ucundaki topuz bu uzamsal çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesnenin veya oluşumun başı ya da en üstte bulunan bölümüdür.
Dağın en üstünde yer alan, kimi tanımda yuvarlak biçimli bölümünü adlandırır.
İnsan başı ile kılıcın sap ucundaki başlık veya topuz da aynı üst ve baş kavramıyla adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir şeyin başı ve en üst bölümü üzerinde birleşir; dağ tepesi temel örnektir, insan başı ile kılıç topuzu da aynı biçimsel ve uzamsal çizgide yer alır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir nesnenin ya da doğal oluşumun en üst bölümünü ve başını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Baş olma ile uzamsal olarak en üstte bulunma çekirdeğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dağın en üst ve kimi zaman yuvarlak bölümünün adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dağa özgü en üst bölüm uzmanlaşmasını doğrudan korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan başının veya başka bir şeyin baş sayılan üst bölümünün kastedildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üst bölümün baş olarak kavranmasını kısa ve doğal biçimde verir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıcın sap ucunda bulunan başlık ya da topuz parçası anlatılırken kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kılıca özgü baş veya üst parça uzmanlaşmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol başla ilgili renk, büyüklük, yaralanma, sayım ve alışveriş kullanımlarına kadar uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki kol da insanın veya başka bir şeyin başını ve en üst bölümünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Baş ve üst bölüm çekirdekleri yakındır; bu kol tepe ve topuz biçimini öne çıkarırken komşu kol başı daha geniş varlık ve kullanım alanlarında işler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol insan başını ve kılıç topuzunu da üst veya baş kavramına bağlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol yüksekliği hörgüç, soy üstünlüğü ve toplumsal onur alanlarına genişletir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki kol da bir şeyin en yüksek, öne çıkan tepe bölümünü anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu kol somut baş ve üst parça sınırında kalır; komşu kol fiziksel doruktan toplumsal yüceliğe uzanan daha geniş bir yükseklik alanı kurar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu kol başı, tepeyi ve en üstte bulunan parçayı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu kol sayı, miktar veya ölçü bakımından azlığı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Aynı kökün sesçe yakın iki ayrı anlam kolu olmaları dışında ortak çekirdekleri yoktur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu anlam uzamsal bir üst bölüm adıdır; komşu anlam ise çokluğun karşıtı olan nicelik durumudur.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس القلة بمعنى الصغر أو العدد القليل، وليس إناء القُلَّة

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi büyük bir küp veya iri kap anlamında birleşir; iki kaplık ölçü ve belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler de aynı kap anlamını somutlaştırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol büyük bir kap türünü ve onun ölçü değerini kapsar; nicelik azlığı veya dağ tepesi anlamını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Büyük küp anlamı çekirdektir; belirli bir bölgeye bağlanan kap adı ile iki kaplık ölçü yalnızca kendi yapılardaki uzmanlaşmalardır.

concept_map.definition: Büyük bir küpü veya küpe benzeyen iri kabı bildirir. Belirli bir bölgenin iri küpleri ve iki böyle kabın aldığı miktar bu kap anlamına bağlı özel kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Küpe benzeyen, özellikle sıvı taşımaya veya saklamaya elverişli büyük bir kaptır.
Belirli bir bölgeyle anılan iri küpler veya büyük toprak kaplar bu adın tanınmış bir türünü oluşturur.
İki büyük kap, bu iki kabın kendisini veya onların aldığı sıvı miktarını bildiren bir ölçü değeri kazanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar iri bir küp veya büyük kap üzerinde birleşir; tanınmış bölgesel kaplar büyüklüğü örnekler, iki kaplık kullanım ise nesne adını kapasite ölçüsüne taşır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Küpe benzeyen iri kabı adlandıran temel ve en doğal Türkçe karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kabın küp türünde ve olağandan büyük oluşunu birlikte korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yükü taşıma veya taşıyabilme ile öznenin yükselip harekete geçmesini aynı kolda açıkça toplar; kuşun uçuşa kalkması, göğün yükselmesi ve yolcuların yüklenip ayrılması ayrı katılımcı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Taşıma, yükselme ve yüklenerek yola koyulma bu kolun sınırıdır; salt sayısal azlık bu anlamlara katılmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yük taşıma ile yükselme çekirdek çizgileri ayrılır; ağır bulut taşıma, uçuşa kalkma ve yolcuların ayrılması yalnızca kendi özne ve yapılarında geçerlidir.

concept_map.definition: Bir yükü kaldırıp taşıyabilmeyi veya üstlenmeyi ve bir öznenin yükselerek harekete geçmesini bildirir. İkinci çizgi kuşun uçuşa kalkmasını, göğün yükselmesini ve yolcuların yüklenip yola koyulmasını kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi kaldıracak gücü bulmak, onu taşımak veya yük olarak üstlenmektir.
Bir öznenin aşağıdaki konumundan yükselmesi veya kuş gibi harekete ve uçuşa başlamasıdır.
Yolcuların yüklerini alıp bulundukları yerden ayrılarak yolculuğa başlamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar bir yükü kaldırıp taşıma ile yukarı kalkarak harekete geçme çizgilerini bir araya getirir; kuş, gök, bulut ve yolcu örnekleri katılımcıya göre bu iki çizgiyi somutlaştırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kişiyi korku veya öfke yüzünden tutan titreme ve silkinişi açıkça tanımlar; genel hareket kararsızlığı değil, duygusal tetikleyicisi bulunan bedensel bir sarsıntı söz konusudur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol insanda korku veya öfkeyle beliren titremeyle sınırlıdır; nesnelerin genel sallanma ve yerinde duramama hali ayrı koldadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Duygudan doğan titreme temel addır; kişiyi titremenin tutması ve öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi yalnızca ilgili yapılara bağlı anlatımlardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın korku veya öfke yüzünden titremesi, ürpermesi ya da bedensel olarak silkelenmesidir. Durum, kişiyi bir titreme nöbetinin tutması veya öfkenin titremeyle dışa vurulması biçiminde anlatılabilir.

facets.statement: İnsan bedeninde beliren titreme, ürperti veya istemsiz silkiniş halidir.
Titremenin belirleyici nedeni korku ya da öfkedir.
Belirli yapılarda titremenin kişiyi tutması veya kişinin öfkeden titrer hale gelmesi anlatılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar insandaki titreme ve silkinişte birleşir; korku ile öfke başlıca nedenlerdir ve durum hem kişiyi tutan bir nöbet hem öfkenin bedensel belirtisi olarak anlatılır.

error_profile.preserves: Korku veya öfke koşulunu ve bunun doğurduğu bedensel titremeyi birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Öfke nedenini ve onunla birlikte ortaya çıkan titremeyi korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi hareket ettirip sallandırma, nesnenin bulunduğu yerde kararlı duramaması ve hareketin çıkardığı sesi birlikte verir; bunlar tek bir fiziksel hareket olayının neden, sonuç ve işitsel yönleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu kol genel fiziksel oynama, kararsızlık ve hareket sesiyle ilgilidir; korku veya öfkeden doğan insana özgü titreme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak kolun hareket ettirme, sallanma, yerinde duramama ve hareket sesi anlamlarını kapsar; özel bir yapının anlamı genelleştirilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi hareket ettirerek yerinden oynatmayı ve onun kararsızca sallanıp bulunduğu yerde duramamasını bildirir; bu hareketin çıkardığı ses de aynı olayın işitsel yönüdür.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi hareket ettirip onun yerinden oynamasına ve sarsılmasına neden olmaktır.
Nesnenin bulunduğu yerde sabit kalmayıp sallanması, oynaması veya düzensiz hareket etmesidir.
Sallanma ve yer değiştirme sırasında çıkan ses, hareket olayının işitsel belirtisi olarak adlandırılır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanımlar dışarıdan hareket ettirme ile nesnenin kararsızca sallanıp yerinde duramaması üzerinde birleşir; hareketin sesi bu fiziksel olayın ayrılmaz işitsel belirtisi olarak eklenir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, görmeyi hem gözle algılama hem de gözün işlevine benzetilen içsel kavrayış olarak kuruyor. Doğrudan göz tanıklığı bu çekirdeğin duyusal gerçekleşimidir; zihinsel görüş, uyku düşü ve başkalarına görünme amacı bu dalın dışında kalır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dalın çekirdeği görsel ya da içsel algıdır; belirli söz öbekleri ve bakma çabası ayrı kullanımlar olarak tutulur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın görme çekirdeği ile doğrudan göz tanıklığını ve görmeye çalışma bildiren bağlı kullanımlar birbirine karıştırılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi gözle ya da göz işlevi gören içsel kavrayışla algılamaktır. Gözün eriştiği yerde doğrudan görme, bu anlamın duyusal ve tanıklığa dayalı gerçekleşimidir.
